notes: The farm and the valley share one frame, +x east and +y north in metres from the lamp niche in the north gatepost; the bend is 1.2 km out along the road east at (1040, −580).

Dawn comes straight down the road from the east, so the farewell stands in the bar of first light through the gateway, the father's face lit and the son's back to the sun, and Asher leaves east into the sunrise.

The jenny stands loaded in the gateway's south half; Miriam brings the bread up the lane from the ovens; Eliab steps out of the north post's shadow, the cold lamp in its niche at his shoulder, to bless his son.

W01 to W10 are one take circling father and son, from the jenny's bags past Miriam's bread and behind the son's shoulder to the niche, ending behind the father's shoulder on the road; one stitch on the bread, the rest continues.

The Scene 9 FLASH of the purse and its one coin is a Resolve insert cut into W01 on the stitched bags; Scene 1A's FLASH of a man holding out his own cloak at the bend of a road is taken from W12 at setup S09.

Amos is absent from the gate; he comes down the road after his brother and catches him where the road rounds the last spur of the hill and runs out straight and open to the east, about twenty minutes after dawn.

The sun at the bend is still low in the east (350°), so Asher walks on straight into it; W12 stitches to W13 on the cloak's dark goat-hair wool, and W16 cuts to W17 to fold the minutes until he is a speck about 400 m out.
At dusk Eliab lights the lamp from the yard side of the niche with flint and striker, as at every dark, weeps facing the road through the niche, and turns his back on it to give the order.
Shallum is crossing the yard toward the house, about 15 m off, so the evening order reaches someone; the oxen are in the byre by the north wall.
The blessing is spoken at about 2.1 words a second, so the scene runs about 3.1 minutes against the design note's 2.5.
